Card Q&A.a: This effect trashes an Option card that was placed by a "place this card in the battle area" effect.
Card Q&A.q: What does the "trash 1 Option card in your opponent's battle area" effect do, exactly?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 5 or less.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, by trashing 1 of your Option cards in the battle area, it doesn't leave.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Cyberdramon] or [Justimon] in its name or the [CS] trait would leave the battle area, by trashing 1 of your Option cards in the battle area, it doesn't leave.
